newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S.Australia wins A$20 million in export deals.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S.Australia wins A$20 million in export deals.

text.p: A South Australian government agency has won contracts worth about A$20 million to manage development projects for the Thai and Chinese governments, state Infrastructure Minister John Olsen said on Monday.
Olsen said the projects, awarded to SAGRIC International, the state government's technology transfer company, could lead to major opportunities for private equipment and service sales.

SAGRIC has won an A$18.5 million contract, through Australia's overseas aid agency AusAID, to manage a project for the rapid expansion in the number of science and engineering places in Thai univerisities, Olsen said.
The project also would assist Thailand's Ministry of University Affairs to buy A$200 million of educational equipment necessary to support development, he said in a statement.
"Major opportunities for Australian and South Australian involvement in equipment sales are expected to arise," he said.

Olsen said SAGRIC, in association with other South Australian and Queensland public bodies, also had been awarded a seed sector commercialisation project in China, worth A$1 million over two years, which should also open opportunities for exports to the Chinese seed industry.
